entries.summary: Added private, revocable calendar subscriptions for personal sign-ups and all Media Club events, with dashboard access and Google Calendar shortcuts.
Shortened student names with database safeguards, improved event browsing and date pickers, and fixed links to Settings tabs and event details.
Improved announcements and the inbox, added My week and crew-opening hints, and made equipment reservations and signup clearer.
Refreshed themes and Settings, with smoother update history and typed introductions on the public site.
Brought commitments into a daily agenda and made search and schedule filters easier to use.
